description: This header file defines the internal API functions related to Web URI Path management within the Web Uri Path Object. It contains function prototypes for internal operations such as checking removability, getting/setting path names, managing resource ownership, and URI path management.

methods.name: WebUpoIsRemoveable
methods.description: Checks if the Web Uri Path Object instance can be removed.

methods.name: WebUpoGetPathName
methods.description: Retrieves the current path name from the Web Uri Path Object.

methods.name: WebUpoSetPathName
methods.description: Sets the path name for the Web Uri Path Object.

methods.name: WebUpoGetResourceOwner
methods.description: Gets the resource owner handle associated with the Web Uri Path Object.

methods.name: WebUpoSetResourceOwner
methods.description: Sets the resource owner handle for the Web Uri Path Object.

methods.name: WebUpoReset
methods.description: Resets the Web Uri Path Object to its default state.

methods.name: WebUpoGetUriPath
methods.description: Retrieves the URI path object associated with a specified path.

methods.name: WebUpoAddUriPath
methods.description: Adds a new URI path to the Web Uri Path Object.

methods.name: WebUpoDelUriPath
methods.description: Deletes a specific URI path from the Web Uri Path Object.

methods.name: WebUpoDelAllUriPaths
methods.description: Deletes all URI paths from the Web Uri Path Object.
